title: XID (globally unique, sortable)
summary: An XID is a 12-byte, 20-character base32 (Crockford) identifier: a 4-byte Unix timestamp (seconds), a 3-byte machine id, a 2-byte process id, and a 3-byte counter. Designed as a Mongo ObjectId alternative.

notes: Encoded as 20 Crockford base32 chars; URL-safe and sortable.
